random_seed_note: The offline arcade constructor exposes no seed argument for bp35; seed 0 is the repository convention for this deterministic default environment. All diagnostic endpoints were independently rebuilt from fresh Arcade instances.
duration_note: Measured wall time from creation of the live-only round-21 probe harness through completion of the final focused verification rerun.
total_env_steps_used_note: Approximate, not an exact metered claim: at least 90 fresh environments are present in retained probe logs (each replaying the 342-action prefix), plus deepcopy search branches and short trials whose steps were not globally instrumented.
reproduction_note: This verifies the reported negative diagnostic endpoints, NOT a level-9 win. ROUTE_A, HIGH_X15_RETURN, DOOR_A, TOP_X15_MAX, and A45_HIGH_RETURN were each replayed three more times from independent fresh Arcade instances after exploration; all 15 endpoints reproduced their expected normalized hashes, remained levels_completed=8, and remained NOT_FINISHED/alive. Since no win occurred, arc_solver_kit.reproduce(claimed_level=9) was correctly not invoked and no level was banked.
reproducibility_checksum_note: sha256 of the compact canonical JSON in reproducibility_basis, serialized with sorted insertion order and no whitespace.
narrative: Ninth dedicated L9 round. No win; bp35 remains honestly banked at 8/9. This round materially revises the earlier structural null without fabricating closure. Pillars are not cosmetic state noise: clicking a full 5x5 body rewrites neighboring six-pixel-lattice cells, and the player can be carried vertically by six world rows or routed horizontally through the resulting corridor. A deterministic 39-action L9 route reaches the goal column at player absolute anchor approximately (15,49), with the goal stable at approximately (15,68). A longer 83-action loop climbs back through the tower, reaches approximately (15,-11), reverses gravity, and returns to (15,49). Four distinct one-shot gravity switches were mapped at approximate world y=-45,-21,+27,+39; different switch-consumption histories can produce pixel-identical local frames. Thus round 20's simple claim that the player never escapes the original cols>=13 room is too weak: a much larger vertical tower is reachable. The stronger obstruction nevertheless survives all bounded tests here: across every prefix of the 83-action loop and the only persistent viewport-edge-pillar variant (84 + 85 endpoint states, four LEFT probes apiece), the player never crosses x=15. At the closest goal view, a safely rebuilt stride-2 sweep tested 1,024 screen coordinates; all 18 changing outcomes were known switches or pillar bodies at y<=30, none was lethal, and no coordinate at y>=32 changed the intervening wall, goal pocket, or player state. A prior search-pruning rule was also corrected: a color-15 component smaller than 20 pixels is interactive when it is a full pillar clipped by viewport y=0 or y=62; such edge pillars must not be discarded merely by visible pixel count. All 16 top-edge masks and all 8 bottom-edge masks were tested. They alter remote pillar topology, but preserve the same 19-pixel player-to-goal vertical gap; only bottom x=45 persisted through the first descent, and that difference washed out after the full high loop. A new door timing route opened the left E door from x=21, removed the blocking body, reversed gravity before entering x=15, and replayed the complete descent; it converged exactly to ROUTE_A's goal-column endpoint rather than opening the goal barrier. Attempts to cap an opened door shaft failed for a grounded reason: the 12-pixel eye-end components above the doors are inert, while the clickable bodies below grow away from the eye and cannot seed a cap above the door. Partial full-state and ACTION7 searches found no win and are reported only as partial coverage, not as an exhaustive proof. The deliverable is therefore a reproducible new map/mechanic correction and stronger bounded structural evidence, not a claimed clear.
novel_mechanics_found: Pillar-body clicks are reachability-changing lattice rewrites, not cosmetic growth: they can carry the player vertically by six absolute rows and enable horizontal transfers through the tower.
L9 contains four independently consumable gravity switches at approximate world y=-45,-21,+27,+39. Pixel-identical settled frames can alias different remote consumed-switch histories.

A full pillar clipped by the viewport edge remains clickable even when its visible color-15 component has fewer than 20 pixels. Size-only component pruning used by earlier searches was unsound; edge contact must be retained.

The player can reach the goal's own x=15 column at absolute y approximately 49 and can traverse a vertical loop from approximately y=-11 to y=49. This retracts the overly simple prior model that only the original room was reachable, while leaving a 19-pixel wall-separated gap to the stable goal at y approximately 68.
bounded_negative_results: Safe stride-2 coordinate sweep at the closest x15/y49 goal view: 1,024 coordinates, 18 non-no-op outcome groups, 0 death groups, maximum affected target row 30, and 0 changing coordinates whose hitbox begins at row 32 or below.
Prefix lateral scan: 84 states along the normal high loop and 85 along the x45 edge-pillar variant; four LEFT actions at every state; minimum settled player x=15, 0 wins, and 0 deaths.

All 8 masks of the three bottom-clipped pillars at the pre-switch view were replayed through the full descent. x27 and x39 washed out; x45 produced a distinct alive L8 endpoint (normalized color-15 250 versus 242), but no mask won.

All 16 masks of four top-clipped pillars at the x15/y49 view were followed by the remaining gravity switch. Every mask remained alive at L8 with player/goal separation unchanged; differences were confined to pillar topology above the player.

Opening the left door from x21, clearing the x15 body, flipping gravity before entering the door column, and completing the full descent produced the exact ROUTE_A endpoint hash rather than a passage into the goal pocket.
ACTION1, ACTION2, and ACTION3 were compared at the closest goal view and were pixel- and trajectory-identical LEFT actions; mixing them did not squeeze through the divider.

Two deepcopy searches were partial only: one expanded 180 nodes / generated 1,354 outcomes / observed 393 full states; another expanded 80 / generated 492 / observed 197. Neither won. An ACTION7 DFS also found no better goal gap before being stopped; none is claimed exhaustive.

absolute_connectivity.coordinate_caveat: Absolute y is reconstructed by accumulating fixed-camera animation trajectories and camera translations from public f.frame layers; screen endpoints re-center after vertical motion.

coordinate_sweep.scope_caveat: This is exhaustive on the even-coordinate stride-2 lattice, not every individual pixel. Every known 5x5 hitbox is sampled by that lattice; no claim is made about hypothetical one-pixel targets.

switch_history_aliases.result: Multiple histories converged to identical local x15/y49 or high-tower pixels; consuming the remaining switch reversed gravity away from the goal and did not win.

diagnostic_routes.door_a_delta: At ROUTE_A prefix length 12, insert click(15,33), then execute original action 13 click(15,39), original action 15 click(3,3), original action 14 LEFT, followed by original actions 16-39.
diagnostic_routes.a45_delta: At ROUTE_A prefix length 14, insert click(45,62), then execute original actions 15-39. Appending high_loop_extension converges to the normal HIGH_X15_RETURN endpoint.

dead_ends: Door-shaft cap from the visible eye ends: eye-end blocks are inert; clickable bodies below cannot grow toward/through the eye to cap the open shaft.
Open left door before entering x15 under reversed gravity, then full descent: converges to the ordinary goal-column endpoint.
Alternative ACTION1/2/3 squeeze through the x15 barrier: exact same public frame and trajectory.
All viewport-edge pillar masks: topology changes but no new player region or win; the only persistent first-descent difference washes out after the high loop.
One additional support click beyond the x15 high endpoint: player flies off the open top and dies; no higher resting region was found.

acceptance_gates.principle: Each of five key negative routes reproduced three times after exploration (15/15 fresh endpoints).

solve_provenance.principle: Only offline_arcade(), env.reset(), env.step(), _game_action(), and public returned frame/state fields were used. The bp35 implementation source was never opened or inspected.

absolute_coordinates.principle: Derived solely from public multi-layer animation trajectories and camera-relative frame registration; approximate values are labeled approximate.

win_claim.principle: No win claim. levels_completed never exceeded 8.
